title: How I create low poly assets using AI for an RTS game I am developing
author: Big-Dependent9623
selftext:
I often see new AI game developers use high-poly AI-generated assets that they get from [Tripo.ai](http://Tripo.ai) or Meshy directly. While these can generate good looking assets, they are hard to work with / edit and have poor performance due to high poly counts. 

  
So I wanted to share the workflow I use to create low poly assets that give you a lot of control over the art while still being fast to develop. 

Here's the post: [https://playwarpact.com/blog/lowpoly-hybrid/](https://playwarpact.com/blog/lowpoly-hybrid/)

Would love to hear any feedback or techniques you use that can make this better!
